author: Huawei
description:
Ever wondered how a tiny piece of iron ore becomes part of a car, a bridge or even a foldable phone? 

Follow its journey through conveyor belts, extreme heat and precision rolling.

At every step, steelworkers and AI work together to turn raw materials into the steel that shapes our world.

One ore. One journey. Endless possibilities. https://bit.ly/4zeXjyp #Huawei #AI #SmartManufacturing #SteelIndustry
title: One Ore. One Journey. Powered by People & AI
